$comment: Contract for workspace/reports/variadic_calls.json, written by scripts/variadic_calls.py run (and by api_harness.generate when the report is missing or was made from another model): the call sites of the model's variadic API entry points in the target's own programs (the sources of the build's executables: tests, examples), read from clang's AST without running anything. The format is the last fixed parameter, which must be `const char *`. A call site is usable when its format is a string literal and every argument after it is the address of a declared object or an array passed by name; `cases` groups the usable sites of a function by (format, varargs). Read by api_harness.py (one `variadic` dispatch case per case) and seed_harvest.py write (seeds from `data`). A status other than ok is a reason, never a failure of Phase 0: without call sites the function stays in the sidecar's `api_skipped`.

vararg.$comment: The object behind one argument after the format: its type as declared at the call site, and how it is passed (`addr`: `&object`; `array`: the array by name).

case.$comment: `format`: the literal's bytes as latin-1 text; `format_param`: its parameter index; `sites`: the call sites grouped here; `callers`: some of them as `source:function`; `data`: per distinct call site, the string literals among the other fixed arguments ({parameter index: hex of the bytes before the first NUL}).

function.$comment: `key`: the model's function id; `fixed`: its fixed parameters; `sites`: every call site found; `unusable`: those of them that are not usable (`skipped` lists the first ones with the reason).

model_generated_at.$comment: the `generated_at` of the model the functions came from: api_harness.generate harvests again when the model on disk has another

sources.$comment: `scanned`: sources parsed (each names one of the functions); `library`: sources of library units, left out; `not_calling`: program sources that name none of the functions; `missing`: not in the work tree; `failed`: clang gave no AST; `over_cap`: left out by the cap on parsed sources.
